stance_summary: Valuation stretch without a dated transmission can stay wrong through the 5% ACT/365 full-$100m vig; the live discrepancy is Canada 2Y 140bp cheap versus the US after an already-priced Fed hike, with BoC energy-pass-through minutes and still-firm Canadian activity as the identifiable repricing path. Express it in CA-US_2Y rates RV, not in USDCAD, and put paper risk on at the frozen executable mark.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Short CA-US_2Y rates RV at executable_marks.rates_rv.CA-US_2Y -140.0 bps (2026-09-17): pay Canada 2Y versus receive US 2Y so the spread becomes less negative as BoC energy-pass-through risk is priced versus an already-delivered Fed hike.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: Short USDCAD at executable_marks.spot_fx.USDCAD 1.4010471204188482 (2026-09-18): CAD firmer if Canadian yields catch up to the US.
expression_comparison.rationale: The discrepancy lives in the CA minus US 2Y yield gap, not in the FX residual. CA-US_2Y is at the 3.77th percentile of the 1y market_state sample and 4.31st percentile of the 5y sample with a 5d change of -15bp (opportunities.series CA-US_2Y z -2.17). USDCAD versus CA-US_2Y is a weak association (r_squared 0.022, status weak), USDCAD is only the 74th percentile of its 1y spot sample, and the 140bp 2Y differential / 60d vol carry screen favors long USD versus CAD so spot fights carry. Rates RV owns the tenor of the BoC policy catalyst, is receive-US / pay-CA carry-supportive, and is the default when both expressions are available.

trade.structure: short CA-US_2Y cross-market rates RV (pay CA 2Y / receive US 2Y)
trade.thesis: FACT: On 2026-09-16 the Fed delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% after interest-rate futures had a greater-than-90% probability of that hike; August CPI is cited as keeping the Fed tightening bias intact; US 2Y is 4.76% as of 2026-09-18 (1y percentile 99.80, z_1y 2.84). FACT: CA 2Y is 3.27% as of 2026-09-17 (1y percentile 97.82, z_1y 2.46) so CA-US_2Y is -140.0bp, 1y percentile 3.77, 5y percentile 4.31, 5d -15bp, 1m -17bp. FACT: BoC minutes dated 2026-09-16 flag higher energy pass-through risk; Canada August headline CPI held at 3% with core/trim/median near 2%; a separate retained item warns energy-market shock absorbers are weakening; CA activity temperature is 53.2 on Q2 real GDP +0.8% q/q and a stronger Ivey PMI, with consumer 52.5. INFERENCE: The residual mispricing is not US too cheap after a pre-priced hike into 99th-percentile US yields; it is Canada still 140bp below the US at the policy tenor while the BoC has just flagged energy pass-through and domestic activity/consumer gauges are the warmest of the four-country set. Paying CA 2Y versus receiving US 2Y is the expression that owns that catch-up. UNKNOWN: next BoC date, next Canadian CPI date, and whether oil modest post-workaround ease dominates the pass-through warning. AU housing (NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values >7% off peak) is a real but slower grind without a dated RBA meeting in this packet, so it is not the primary trade.
trade.mispricing: CA-US_2Y at -140.0bp is a 1y 3.77th percentile / 5y 4.31st percentile common-date gap that cheapened 15bp in five sessions into BoC minutes that were hawkish on energy, while the US leg of the gap already embeds a hike that was >90% priced. That is a fundamentals-versus-pricing gap at the 2Y tenor, not a z-score fade.
why_now: Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 was already >90% priced in futures, so incremental US 2Y hawkish surprise is largely spent (US 2Y 4.76%, 1y percentile 99.80).

BoC minutes on 2026-09-16 flag higher energy pass-through while CA-US_2Y printed -140.0bp on 2026-09-17 after a -15bp 5d slide (opportunities.series move z -2.17) — Canada cheapened into the catalyst instead of repricing it.

Canada August headline CPI still 3% y/y (core/trim/median near 2%) and a retained energy shock-absorber warning keep the pass-through channel live into the next Canadian inflation/BoC communication window.
CA activity 53.2 and consumer 52.5 (Q2 GDP +0.8% q/q, retail/income/spending impulses clearly stronger) constrain a BoC look-through even though labor cooled (employment -42k, wages +2.0% y/y).
Flat books still pay 5% ACT/365 on the full $100m; an identified 2Y catch-up path with receive-US/pay-CA carry is a better use of the clock than waiting on a housing grind or an undated RBA meeting.

paper_capital.funding_hurdle_rationale: The 13 funded seats pay 5% ACT/365 on the full $100m every day whether or not risk is on, so HOLD is a guaranteed leak. Short CA-US_2Y is marked at the frozen -140.0bp executable print, maps to a book-engine rates_rv instrument, and has a 2-6 week BoC/CPI transmission rather than an open-ended valuation hope. Receive-US 2Y 4.76% versus pay-CA 2Y 3.27% is a +140bp differential that supports sitting in the RV. Notional is $8m rather than the full allocation because RV marks are in bps; a 12bp move back to the 2026-09-14 -128bp common-date print is a large enough paper P&L relative to weeks of the 5% clock without turning the book into an oversized duration bet. Saudi oil-workaround and cooler CA labor keep confidence at 58, which is still enough to OPEN rather than donate the vig.
